meta.name: google-ads-audit
meta.description: Google Ads account audit and business context setup. Use for account-health audits and business-context setup. Trigger on "audit my ads", "ads audit", "set up my ads", "onboard", "account overview", "how's my account", "ads health check", "what should I fix in my ads", or when the user is new to NotFair and hasn't run an audit before.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断谷歌广告账户健康度并列出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在管理谷歌广告却说不清账户哪里出了问题
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose Google Ads account health and list fixes to apply
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads and want to know what to fix in your account

howto.what: 要求审计 Google Ads 时,Claude 会读取账户数据,检查广告活动、关键词和转化,给出每月浪费金额、需求捕获率和单次转化成本三项指标,并指出问题与修复方向;它只出报告,不改账户,还会保存业务背景与客户画像供后续使用。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计或检查 Google Ads 账户(如说“audit my ads”、“set up my ads”等)时触发;若用户是 NotFair 新用户且尚未做过审计,也会触发。

say.text: 帮我审计一下 Google Ads 账户。
say.note: 会拉取数据并输出三项核心指标。

say.text: 我的广告账户健康状况怎么样?
say.note: 触发健康检查,给出浪费点和修复建议。

say.text: 给我一个广告账户整体概览。
say.note: 会生成账户健康审计报告。

howto.what_en: Given a Google Ads audit request, Claude reviews account data, campaigns, keywords and conversions, and reports waste, demand captured %, CPA with top driver and fix. Read-only; saves business context and personas.
howto.when_en: When the user says 'audit my ads', 'set up my ads', or similar requests to review their Google Ads account, or when the user is new to NotFair and has never run an audit before.

say_en.note: Pulls data and returns the three core metrics.

say_en.text: How healthy is my ads account?
say_en.note: Runs a health check and lists waste plus fixes.

say_en.text: Give me an overview of my ads account.
say_en.note: Generates a full account health report.
